name: lavish-axi
description: HTML is the new markdown. Lavish is the new editor for your HTML artifacts.

issues.title: Feature: read-only session list at the server root (local + tailnet), companion to #215/#216
Mermaid snippet inherits presentation defaults: basis-spline edges + Trebuchet text
Feature: review a multi-page artifact in one session (keep annotation working on sibling HTML pages)
Send to Agent: UI blocked / agent click finds no queued annotations
A stale layout-warning chip rejects the reviewer's entire batch, with no error shown anywhere
Change default theme from luxury: saturated amber body text (4.66:1) and no prefers-color-scheme respect
feat(chrome): light and system appearance for the editor chrome
